jobs.title: Associate, Exit Planning and Transaction Support
jobs.description:
Company Overview

We are the better way to work in finance. As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE—where sponsors and CFOs meet. Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value—supporting the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.

If you crave challenging work and are looking to grow, come solve complex issues alongside 1,600+ finance & technology experts in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Backed by premier private equity firms and headquartered in New York with 11 offices around the globe, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm looking for people who want to be part of building something great. Come make your mark.

Strategic Finance Practice | Exit Planning and Transaction Support Sub-Practice

This position is an exciting opportunity to join our Exit Planning and Transaction Support sub-practice, which is a dedicated, transaction-focused team within our broader Strategic Finance practice. This position requires candidates to have 3 to 5 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, or quality of earnings.

Strategic Finance: Accordion’s Strategic Finance practice provides strategic advisory to CFOs to unlock end-to-end value creation, partnering with Finance teams on building capabilities to enhance performance visibility, planning activities, and data analytics to enable and accelerate value creation. By combining extensive operational FP&A experience, data and technology skills, and a proprietary engagement model, we develop and implement tools and processes and deliver solutions that meet the rigor and pace required in a private equity-backed environment.

Exit Planning and Transaction Support: Our Exit Planning and Transaction Support sub-practice, sitting within our broader Strategic Finance practice, focuses on the full spectrum of M&A execution: from financial modeling, valuation, and analytical support to serving in a bolt-on corporate development capacity. From quarterbacking current deals to developing playbooks and best practices for a robust acquisition strategy, from the fund level to the portfolio level, from platforms to add-ons to carve outs, “no job is too small, no fee is too big.” In addition to analyzing the financial and operational data, we help quantify current and future value creation opportunities, enabling investors to easily understand the trapped value within the business.

This position can be based in any of our U.S. offices and is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work remotely 2 days per week, with preferred locations being NYC, Boston, Chicago, or Dallas.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

What You’ll Do:

As an Associate on a lean, cross-functional team, you will work collaboratively with a diverse set of colleagues to guide clients through a variety of transaction-related projects focused on preparing companies for sale and supporting them throughout the deal process. You will:

- Work with company management, private equity deal and operating teams, investment bankers, and other third parties to support the development of an equity story and other go-to-market materials

- Utilize both Excel and Business Intelligence tools (PowerBI, Power Query, and Power Pivot) to develop a variety of granular financial, operational, and business segment analyses

- Analyze, quantify, and validate deal-related assumptions including synergies, add-backs, and pro-forma financials

- Manage and / or support the development and population of an investor-ready data room

- Work with CFOs and their teams, respond to due diligence and other deal-related questions from either financial (private equity) or strategic (corporate) buyers

- Travel to client site as needed

The following representative engagement is emblematic of the type of work you’ll do as an Associate at Accordion: A PE-owned SaaS company requires sale preparation and related transaction support. Accordion has been engaged to take a leadership role alongside the CFO in the sell-side process. The deliverables include historical financial reporting, financial and operational KPIs, a 5-year financial projection model, and identification of value creation initiatives (realized and yet to be realized) to maximize the exit valuation. The Accordion team will serve as an extension of the CFO’s office to support a sale by responding to requests from investment banks, the executive team, and the sponsor during the preparation process, and to potential buyers during the sale process.

You Have:

- Required background of 3 to 5 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, or quality of earnings

- Proven ability to leverage Excel and other tools to manage, simplify, analyze, and present large and complex datasets

- Experience with Business Intelligence tools (PowerBI, Power Query, and Power Pivot) is highly desired

- High attention to detail and advanced quantitative skills, especially as it relates to financial modeling and corporate valuation

- Transactional finance experience, as well as an understanding of operational finance

- Prior experience preparing reports, presentations, and memos; ability to present data-driven insights in a clear, succinct, and comprehensive manner

- Strong drive and motivation, adhering to the highest professional standards in working with clients and colleagues

- An ability to work collaboratively and independently in a team-oriented environment, understanding how to take initiative and seek guidance when needed in order to advance your projects

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics; MBA is a plus

You Are:

- Excited to be part of a growing team, with a focus on driving future growth

- Passionate about delivering exceptional client service

- Knowledgeable about the relationship between private equity sponsors and their portfolio companies, particularly within the office of the CFO

- Willing to get your hands dirty in the details of a project while simultaneously seeing the whole picture

- Comfortable managing projects with multiple complex workstreams while also focused on your single workstream (you are managing and doing)

- A self-starter with a strong work ethic

- Full of entrepreneurial spirit and comfortable in a fluid, flat organization

- Able to effectively communicate complex issues and solutions, and raise issues to senior team members when necessary

- A team player, able to work with team members across all levels

- Someone who enjoys mentoring others and doing meaningful work

- A leader of others; you lead by example

The annual salary for this role ranges from: $120,000 to $170,000 + benefits + bonus.

Actual compensation packages are determined by evaluating a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to geographic location, skill set, years and depth of experience, education, certifications, cost of labor and internal equity.

jobs.title: Digital Advisory Director
jobs.description:
Company Overview

We are the better way to work in finance. As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE—where sponsors and CFOs meet. Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive values supporting the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.

If you crave challenging work and are looking to grow, come solve complex issues alongside 1,600+ finance & technology experts in a supportive, collaborative environment.

As we build our European footprint, the London office presents a unique entrepreneurial opportunity to shape our presence and accelerate growth across the region—while benefiting from the support and stability of an established, industry-leading firm.

Backed by premier private equity firms and headquartered in New York with 11 offices around the globe, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm looking for people who want to be part of building something great. Come make your mark.

Practice Description

Accordion’s CFO Technology Practice effectively and efficiently delivers the digital services and solutions to support organizational strategic initiatives.

Our CFO Technology experts work cross-functionally — alongside practitioners from all corners of Accordion — to arm CFOs with the appropriate digital solutions needed to implement the team’s business process recommendations and to capitalize on value creation opportunities. From ERP, CPM, Analytics, Data Integration, RPA, and beyond, CFO Tech provides finance leaders with a single, objective partner capable of delivering from strategy to execution.

This role will be based in our London office. Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location, with the flexibility to work remotely 1-2 days a week, blending the best of both worlds for efficiency and collaboration.

Role Context

CFOs and finance functions in PE-backed businesses frequently face technology challenges that are complex, cross-cutting, and poorly served by single-system or domain expertise. The Digital Advisory Director exists to address exactly these situations. Operating across the full landscape of finance technology e.g., from ERP and CRM through to EPM, automation, and data, this role brings strategic clarity to ambiguous technology problems and orchestrates the right specialist resources to deliver against them. It is a role defined by breadth, commercial judgement, and the ability to connect finance operations with the technology decisions that shape them.

What You’ll Do:

Digital Advisory Delivery

- Lead finance technology diagnostic processes for clients that cut across ERP, CRM, EPM, and adjacent systems, often with a spike in one area depending on the nature of the diagnostic

- Deliver surgical and focused advisory on finance technology strategy, solution architecture, and technology transformation

- Facilitate impartial system selection processes, managing competitive vendor evaluations while maintaining advisory independence

- Provide credible, informed perspective on AI and automation in the finance function including where it adds value, what the risks are, and what readiness looks like

- Rapidly distill insights from data and client interactions to inform technology advisory recommendations that will support the delivery of finance focused value creation

- Lead the technology workstream in transaction-related scenarios including carve-outs, integrations, and first-100-day scenarios

- Define and communicate finance systems architecture recommendations both designing from scratch and articulating the implications of existing architectures to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Technology Programme Delivery

- Operate as programme-level orchestrator on larger system-focused engagements, bringing together deep specialist resources (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Anaplan) to deliver unified outcomes

- Oversee delivery of complex technology transformation programmes across multiple workstreams

- Integrate with other Accordion practices and domain experts (Data and Analytics, Strategic Finance, Transformation etc.) to deliver performance improvement across the finance function

- Carefully manage large complex project budgets and engagement economics on behalf of the wider project team

- Be responsible for coaching and guiding project teams towards A+ delivery for Accordion’s clients

Commercial and CFO Technology Practice Development

- Own key client relationships on projects and act as a trusted advisor to CFOs, finance leaders, and PE operating partners

- Originate follow-on work through consistent high-quality delivery

- Scope, price, and propose advisory engagements

- Play a key role in market-facing business development including support in opportunity origination, proposal development, responding to RFP’s and client relationship building at both the PE sponsor and portfolio company level

- Play a central role in the ongoing development and growth of the CFO Technology Practice in the UK and Europe

You Have

- A minimum of 7 years of experience in technology and digital related roles. Consulting experience is a must have

- Extensive experience advising and/or delivering technology for private equity backed businesses

- Strong and diverse experience across the finance function and related processes, including demonstrated knowledge on how the finance function operates, not just the systems that support it

- Technology solution architecture experience specifically defining finance systems architecture from scratch and explaining the implications of existing architecture to both technical and management audiences alike

- Breadth of exposure across multiple finance and business technologies (e.g., ERP, CRM, EPM, BI, automation tooling). Breadth of experience is preferred versus single-system depth

- Experience overseeing complex transformation or technology programmes within the finance function

- Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams to deliver high quality project outcomes

- A credible and current point of view on AI and automation in the finance function

Preferred

- Hands-on experience evaluating, designing or implementing AI and automation tooling in a finance / OCFO context

- Hands-on experience working with finance systems and software implementation partners

- Exposure to technology and digital topics in a transaction setting e.g., separation and carve-out planning, disentanglement under TSA scenarios, Day 1 readiness etc.

- Experience working directly with PE operating partners and portfolio company CFOs

You Are

- Able to comfortably operate at the pace and intensity that is associated with PE backed businesses including managing high urgency requests, compressed timescales and a push for tangible results

- Able to produce written deliverables to a standard that is expected of PE operating partners and portfolio company management teams. This would include board packs, diagnostic outputs, strategic recommendations

- Comfortable and confident in navigating senior stakeholders with credibility

- Able to move fluidly between strategic and operational levels of detail

- Able to bring clarity to ambiguous situations

- Someone who is comfortable working in small teams with high levels of autonomy and accountability

Location and working arrangement:

- London-based, hybrid with preference for in-office or client-site

- Regular and extensive travel across Europe to work with clients in the relevant jurisdictions

jobs.description:
Company Overview

We are the better way to work in finance. As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE—where sponsors and CFOs meet. Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value—supporting the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.

If you crave challenging work and are looking to grow, come solve complex issues alongside 1,600+ finance & technology experts in a supportive, collaborative environment.

As we build our European footprint, the London office presents a unique entrepreneurial opportunity to shape our presence and accelerate growth across the region—while benefiting from the support and stability of an established, industry-leading firm.

Backed by premier private equity firms and headquartered in New York with 10 offices around the globe, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm looking for people who want to be part of building something great. Come make your mark.

The Role

We are looking for a Director of Technology Sales & Alliances to drive growth across Accordion’s NetSuite and ERP-adjacent offerings, including implementation, optimization, managed services, and AI enablement, across EMEA. This is not a generalist sales role. The right person brings a strong working knowledge of the NetSuite ecosystem, understands how organizations adopt and scale ERP solutions, and has a proven track record selling software and/or professional services, ideally both.

This individual will play a critical role in building Accordion’s brand within NetSuite account teams and the greater partner ecosystem across Europe, and in originating relationships with private equity sponsors and their portfolio companies. They know how to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage credibly with both technical and business stakeholders, and identify where ERP-led transformation can unlock value for the office of the CFO and across the C-suite.

This role sits within Accordion’s CFO Technology practice and is based in our London office. Regular travel across Europe is expected for client meetings, NetSuite field events, QBRs, and sponsor meetings.

What You’ll Do

As part of our growth-focused commercial team, you will:

- Build and own Accordion’s presence within NetSuite account teams across EMEA, developing trusted relationships with AEs, RVPs, and Alliances leaders, including representing Accordion in NetSuite QBRs and field events

- Originate and develop new business opportunities across NetSuite implementation, optimization, managed services, and ERP-adjacent advisory services in Europe

- Develop and maintain relationships with private equity sponsors and operating partners active in the region, introducing Accordion’s CFO technology capabilities across their portfolios

- Bring a strong point of view on how NetSuite and adjacent CFO technology solutions (EPM/CPM, data and analytics platforms, AI enablement) can drive measurable outcomes for clients

- Partner with internal alliances, practice, and industry leadership to shape solutions, define scope, and position differentiated offerings in competitive pursuits

- Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including both technical buyers and executive decision-makers

- Leverage your existing network within NetSuite and the broader ecosystem to generate qualified introductions and accelerate deal velocity, remaining engaged through the full client relationship lifecycle

- Recruit, mentor, and direct junior business development talent as the EMEA sales organization scales

- Maintain accurate pipeline tracking and forecasting, using data to inform strategy and communicate progress to leadership

- Design co-marketing campaigns with NetSuite to engage CFOs and PE operating partners across the region

- Collaborate on go-to-market strategy for ERP and other related technology practices in EMEA

- Develop marketing events, including leading planning of key regional NetSuite events

- Collaborate with marketing and leadership to refine messaging and strengthen Accordion’s brand in the NetSuite ecosystem

- Stay current on NetSuite product evolution, partner programs, and market trends to inform go-to-market strategy

You Have

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise sales, with a meaningful portion focused on NetSuite or ERP-related solutions

- Demonstrated success selling software, professional services, or a combination of both in complex environments

- Experience selling into private equity-backed companies and engaging with PE sponsors

- Strong working knowledge of the NetSuite platform and its core offerings, including how they are implemented and scaled in mid-market and PE-backed organizations

- An established network within NetSuite (account executives, RVPs, partner managers, or alliance leaders) across Europe that you can actively leverage

- Proven ability to generate pipeline, manage long sales cycles, and consistently close deals

- Experience collaborating with delivery teams to shape solutions and ensure successful client outcomes

- Comfort engaging with both technical stakeholders and senior business leaders, including the office of finance

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep knowledge of the relationship between private equity sponsors and their portfolio companies, particularly within the office of the CFO

- Experience with broader CFO technology solutions, including EPM/CPM, data platforms, and AI-enabled offerings

- Prior experience working within or alongside the NetSuite partner and alliance ecosystem in Europe

- Experience recruiting, mentoring, or leading junior sales talent

- Track record of building or scaling a go-to-market motion in a high-growth environment

Who You Are

- Commercially driven and outcomes-focused. You know how to translate relationships into revenue

- Credible in the NetSuite and private equity ecosystems. You speak the language and understand how deals actually get done

- Entrepreneurial and proactive. You do not wait for leads, you create opportunities

- Low ego and highly collaborative. You partner effectively across sales, delivery, and leadership teams

- Data-driven. You manage pipeline rigorously and use insights to improve performance

- Resilient and adaptable. You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments

- A strong communicator. You can clearly articulate complex solutions in a compelling way

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Backed by premier private equity firms and headquartered in New York with 11 offices around the globe, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm looking for people who want to be part of building something great. Come make your mark.

Practice Overview

Our Transactions group brings a methodical and action-oriented approach to identify and create value for our clients. We provide private equity buyers and sellers with a broad continuum of knowledge and tools for diligence, merger planning and post-merger integration, and carve-out support (stand-alone and integrated).

The team combines Integration Management Office (IMO) / Separation Management Office (SMO) expertise with deep Finance & Accounting, Data & Analytics, Operational and Private Equity knowledge across a range of engagements, including pre-deal (e.g. synergy and carve-out diligence) and post-deal (e.g. integration planning, execution and tracking).

As an Associate, you will be a vital member of the team executing M&A projects, focused on the CFO agenda and Finance function. You'll execute and manage projects across sectors, supporting our client service team in developing and executing strategies for transactions.

This role will be based in our NYC or Dallas office locations and is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work remotely 2 days a week. Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

What You’ll Do:

Support client teams and larger, more complex projects in planning and executing operational diligence, merger integration and carve-out initiatives, to include:

- Day 1 readiness

- TSA development and operationalization

- 100-day plans

- Synergy identification and model development

- Program and workstream-level project management

- Executive/sponsor reporting

Depending on the size of the engagement, support or lead the IMO / SMO, including development of functional integration and carve-out plans and execution activities, with heavy focus on cross-functional interdependencies by:

- Facilitating due diligence meetings focused on identifying operational and technology strategy, organizational structures, current state business processes and enabling technology

- Understand client strategy and investment priorities and embed those in our engagement deliverables

- Assist with the development of presentations for client proposals and thought leadership materials

- Drive the development and enhancement of Accordion’s M&A methodologies (diligence, merger integration, carve-out, etc.) and approaches to client delivery

- Mentor and coach our consultants

- Travel to client site as needed

You Have:

- Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience working in operational/ commercial diligence, merger integration, carve-outs, business transformation and change management

- Functional expertise in a variety of areas and in at least two or more of the following:

- Finance & Accounting

- Information Technology

- Human Resources

- Supply Chain

- Commercial / Sales & Marketing

- Consulting firm / industry experience preferred

- IMO / SMO / PMO experience required

- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to influence both internal and external relationships

- Superior problem-solving and analytical skills that can be utilized to translate disparate data into meaningful insights for our clients

- Private industry experience preferred

- Prior experience serving interim or permanent finance roles (i.e. VP Finance, Controller or CFO) helpful but not required

You Are:

- Excited to be part of a growing team, with a focus on driving future growth

- Passionate about delivering exceptional client service

- Knowledgeable about the relationship between Private Equity sponsors and their portfolio companies, particularly within the office of the CFO

- Willing to get your hands dirty in the details of a project while simultaneously seeing the whole picture

- Comfortable managing projects with multiple complex workstreams while also focused on your single workstream (you are managing and doing)

- A self-starter with a strong work ethic

- Full of entrepreneurial spirit and comfortable in a fluid, flat organization

- Able to effectively communicate complex issues and solutions, and raise issues to senior team members when necessary

- A team player, able to work with team members across all levels

- Someone who enjoys mentoring others and doing meaningful work

- A leader of others; you lead by example

The annual salary for this role ranges from: $121,000 to $175,000   USD  + benefits + bonus. Actual compensation packages are determined by evaluating a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education, certifications, cost of labor and internal equity.
